qa_pair.question: Identify the configured vault containing a note that discusses a completed launch retrospective, then find the decision recorded under its Results heading. Return only the vault id.
Across the archived project notes, determine which project has both a release note and a retrospective and return only its project codename.
Find the note tagged with the nested status representing completed work and determine the year in its YAML date property. Return YYYY.
Search the historical meeting notes for the decision to retire the old synchronization worker, follow the linked architecture note, and return only the replacement component name.
Among notes whose filenames mention a retrospective, identify the one whose body references a launch in the second quarter. Return only its filename including extension.
Find the project note that links to a block describing the final rollback criterion. Return only the human-readable block identifier.
Compare the archived launch notes and identify the only project with nested tags for both completed status and infrastructure ownership. Return only its codename.
Locate the historical decision whose alias is displayed as “replacement worker,” follow it, and return only the month name in which adoption completed.
Find all content matches for the retired worker across the fixture vault using pagination if necessary. Which linked note contains the authoritative replacement? Return only its filename.
Determine whether the completed launch retrospective and its linked release note agree on the final outcome. Answer True or False.
